title: Setup Android SDK & build environment
body: Install Android SDK (cmdline-tools, platform-tools, emulator, build-tools 34.0.0, platform 34) and verify dotnet build works for net10.0-android. Run `dotnet build src/TvOptimizer.App/TvOptimizer.App.csproj` successfully.

title: Implement ADB connection flow (ConnectPage)
body: Complete ConnectPage implementation: IP/port input, TLS toggle, pairing code support, connection status display, error handling. Test with real Android TV device via Wireless Debugging.

title: Implement Audit engine UI (AuditPage)
body: Complete AuditPage: refresh button, package list display, tier coloring (TIER_1=green, TIER_2=yellow, HEURISTIC=orange, PROTECTED=red, UNIDENTIFIED=gray), details modal, apply-all button with confirmation dialog.

title: Implement Tweaks UI (TweaksPage)
body: Complete TweaksPage: load current settings via ADB shell, display animation scales/background/doze, allow selection, apply selected tweaks via settings put global/deviceidle commands, refresh after apply.

title: ConfigSync: GitHub raw fetch + local cache
body: Implement ConfigSync service: fetch device configs and curated lists from GitHub raw URLs, cache in AppDataDirectory with TTL (7 days), fallback to cache when offline, match device by fingerprint (model/brand).

title: TLS ADB support & RSA auth verification
body: Verify AdbClient TLS support works with Android TV pairing: test certificate validation, RSA key exchange, AUTH token flow. Ensure both plain TCP and TLS modes work reliably.

title: Low-resource emulator test (CI)
body: Run `scripts/test-emulator-low.sh` to create minimal AVD (1GB RAM, no GPU, SwiftShader, no audio) and deploy app. Verify app launches, ADB connection works, basic UI responsive on constrained emulator.

title: Real device testing on Android TV
body: Test full flow on physical Android TV (Xiaomi A Pro 2026 or similar): Wireless Debugging pairing → ConnectPage → AuditPage → TweaksPage. Verify all tweaks apply correctly and can be reverted.

title: Guard safety rules integration test
body: Verify Guard class (NeverTouch, UniversalProtected, UniversalSafe) correctly blocks dangerous packages in audit engine. Test edge cases: system apps, launcher, telemetry, video stack packages.

title: UI polish: Material3, theming, accessibility
body: Apply Material3 theming: consistent colors, typography, dark mode support, RTL support, accessibility labels. Add loading states, empty states, error banners. Polish Connect/Audit/Tweaks pages.

title: Release build: signed APK & GitHub Actions CI
body: Configure signing (keystore, credentials), create GitHub Actions workflow: build -> test on low-resource emulator -> sign -> upload artifact. Version bump to 0.1.0.
